$comment: Aligned with @typespec/compiler 1.17.0 packages/compiler/src/config/config-schema.ts (TypeSpecConfigJsonSchema) and packages/compiler/src/core/features.ts. AJV nullable:true is represented as JSON Schema type null. features items suggest known compiler feature names and still allow other strings.
title: TypeSpec Project Configuration

kind.description: Set to "project" to mark this directory as a TypeSpec project root.

entrypoint.description: Main TypeSpec file for this project, relative to the config directory. Requires kind: project. When omitted, the compiler resolves exports["."].typespec, then tspMain, then main.tsp.

features.description: Experimental compiler features enabled for this project. Meaningful when kind is project. Known names are suggested. Other strings are allowed so a feature added by a newer compiler is not flagged here; the compiler reports unknown names as config-unknown-feature.

function-declarations.description: Allows use of function declarations without experimental warnings in project code.

declaration-expressions.description: Allows use of declaration expressions (named or anonymous model, scalar, enum and union declarations in expression position) in project code.

auto-decorators.description: Allows use of auto decorator declarations without experimental warnings in project code.

type-info-provider.description: Enables the experimental `$provideTypeInfo` provider allowing libraries to contribute extra information about types to IDE hover and tooling (queried via `program.getTypeInfo`).

union-extends.description: Enables experimental union `extends` clauses in project code.

anyOf.description: Compiler feature name. Names that are not in the bundled list are still accepted by this schema.
